questions.q: What does a consensus algorithm actually do?
options: Determines the finality of transactions — the network's agreement that a transaction happened and can't be undone
Encrypts a user's private key
Sets the price of a cryptocurrency
Creates new wallet addresses
questions.explain: Consensus is how the network collectively agrees a transaction is final, which is what prevents attacks like double-spending.

options: Spending the same funds twice, made possible by weak consensus
Paying double the normal transaction fee
A miner earning two block rewards for one block
Sending a transaction to two wallets by accident
questions.explain: Without strong consensus, someone could send a transaction, have it finalized, and then spend the same money again — a real consensus algorithm prevents this.

questions.q: In Proof of Work, what do miners actually do to produce a block?
options: Solve a random function pushed to the network, earning newly minted coins and fees for the correct answer
Vote based on how much cryptocurrency they own
Simply verify transactions without any computation
Purchase the right to mine from an exchange
questions.explain: Miners solve a random function; the winner earns rewards and gets to push their seen transactions into a finalized block.

questions.q: How does Proof of Stake fundamentally differ from Proof of Work?
options: Validators verify and vote on blocks weighted by how much they've staked, rather than miners solving a computational puzzle
Proof of Stake has no way to confirm transactions at all
Proof of Stake requires more electricity than Proof of Work
There's no real difference between the two
questions.explain: Proof of Stake replaces mining with validators who verify transactions, with influence weighted by staked ether rather than computing power.

questions.q: What is Flashbots/MEV, as described in this lesson?
options: A way to bribe a block producer for advantageous transaction ordering, useful for trading or NFT minting priority
A type of Bitcoin wallet
A consensus algorithm that replaced Proof of Work
A block explorer for Ethereum
questions.explain: Flashbots lets someone pay to get their transaction included in a specific position — a real dynamic in how transactions actually get ordered on-chain.
